title: Yirgacheffe Coffee Region Food
community: Yirgacheffe zone — the world's most celebrated coffee origin
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Yirgacheffe Regional Meal — Tibs with the highland herbs of Yirgacheffe, and a cup of the world's most celebrated coffee (Yirgacheffe natural process, floral and fruity). The experience of eating in the place where the world's finest coffee is grown.
longDesc: Yirgacheffe produces coffee considered by many coffee experts to be the finest arabica on earth — natural process Yirgacheffe with its blueberry, jasmine, and lemon notes. The regional food pairs with this extraordinary coffee.
ingredients: Tibs (ETH022) with Yirgacheffe highland herbs (rosemary, thyme)
// The coffee: Yirgacheffe natural process arabica — brewed in jebena
steps: Make Tibs per ETH022 with highland herbs.
Serve coffee after the meal — the Yirgacheffe tradition.
chefTips: The Yirgacheffe coffee should be brewed medium and served without sugar to appreciate its natural sweetness.
commonMistakes: Over-roasting Yirgacheffe — its light-roast character is the point.
cookingScience: See ETH212 for coffee science. Yirgacheffe natural process coffees retain fruit sugars from the cherry that dry on the bean — producing the characteristic blueberry and jasmine notes that make Yirgacheffe the world's most celebrated coffee origin.
sustainabilityTips: Yirgacheffe coffee — shade-grown in agroforestry systems, the most sustainable coffee in the world.
servedWith: As a complete regional dining experience
storage: Coffee: drink immediately. Food: as per recipes.
healthBenefits: Yirgacheffe coffee has among the highest antioxidant levels of any coffee.
culturalNote: Yirgacheffe is a pilgrimage destination for coffee lovers — the place that produces the world's most celebrated single-origin coffee. To eat Tibs and drink Yirgacheffe in its origin is to experience the complete sensory context of the world's most extraordinary coffee.
